spec.command: python run_hires_quant.py --model Qwen2.5-7B --device cuda:0 --calibration calibration_hires.json --output qwen_hires_results.json --budget 0.25 --num_samples 64 --seq_len 2048 --batch_size 4
spec.hypothesis: 修复 hires profiler 后（加 2-bit + .float()），Qwen2.5-7B hires profiling 的 top-5% concentration 是否仍 >0.50，验证 Claim 3 diagnostic threshold。

experiment_data.notes: D048 PASS: Float32 hires top-5% concentration = 0.6104, well above 0.50 threshold. bf16 range (0.59-0.66) confirmed reliable — float32 falls squarely within it. bf16 bug impact on concentration ~0.01 (negligible, as expected for ratio metric). L0 4 heads contribute 58.6% of total distortion. Lowres concentration (0.42) was due to insufficient profiling resolution (16×512 vs 64×2048), not bf16 artifact. Claim 3 (0.50 diagnostic threshold) fully validated. Note: MCKP allocation here is unconstrained (max_2bit=12), not constrained (max_2bit=8). Unconstrained PPL=10.95; constrained PPL from previous experiments=10.91.
